name: Huge Winch
description: The winch is operated electrically, and outputs its current length.
shortDescription: A building block attached to the end of a 500m mechanical winch that can be raised and lowered.

logicNodes.label: Up
logicNodes.description: Raises the winch cable up when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Down
logicNodes.description: Lowers the winch cable down when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Length
logicNodes.description: The current length of the winch cable in metres.

logicNodes.label: Fluid
logicNodes.description: Fluid connection for the hose coil.
